title: सप्तषष्टितमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 67 · The marriage of Abhimanyu and Uttara

summary.en: Arjuna explains that he lived with the princess as a teacher, like a father, and so cannot marry her. Messengers are sent to friends and allies; Krishna comes with Abhimanyu and the Vrishnis, Drupada and many kings arrive, and Abhimanyu and Uttara are married amid great rejoicing in the Matsya city.
summary.kn: ತಾನು ರಾಜಕುಮಾರಿಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ಗುರುವಾಗಿ, ತಂದೆಯಂತೆ ಇದ್ದುದರಿಂದ ಅವಳನ್ನು ಮದುವೆಯಾಗಲಾರೆ ಎಂದು ಅರ್ಜುನನು ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಮಿತ್ರರಿಗೂ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಕರಿಗೂ ದೂತರನ್ನು ಕಳುಹಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ; ಶ್ರೀಕೃಷ್ಣನು ಅಭಿಮನ್ಯು ಮತ್ತು ವೃಷ್ಣಿಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ ಬರುತ್ತಾನೆ, ದ್ರುಪದ ಮತ್ತು ಅನೇಕ ರಾಜರು ಆಗಮಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ; ಮತ್ಸ್ಯನಗರದಲ್ಲಿ ಮಹೋತ್ಸವದೊಂದಿಗೆ ಅಭಿಮನ್ಯು ಉತ್ತರೆಯರ ವಿವಾಹವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.
summary.hi: अर्जुन समझाते हैं कि वे राजकुमारी के साथ गुरु के रूप में, पिता की तरह रहे, इसलिए उससे विवाह नहीं कर सकते। मित्रों और सम्बन्धियों के पास दूत भेजे जाते हैं; श्रीकृष्ण अभिमन्यु और वृष्णियों के साथ आते हैं, द्रुपद और अनेक राजा पधारते हैं, और मत्स्य नगर में महान उत्सव के बीच अभिमन्यु और उत्तरा का विवाह होता है।
summary.te: తాను రాజకుమారితో గురువుగా, తండ్రిలా ఉన్నందున ఆమెను వివాహమాడలేనని అర్జునుడు వివరిస్తాడు. మిత్రులకు, బంధువులకు దూతలను పంపుతారు; శ్రీకృష్ణుడు అభిమన్యుడు, వృష్ణులతో వస్తాడు, ద్రుపదుడు, అనేక రాజులు వస్తారు; మత్స్యనగరంలో మహోత్సవం నడుమ అభిమన్యుడు, ఉత్తరల వివాహం జరుగుతుంది.
summary.ta: தான் இளவரசியுடன் ஆசிரியனாக, தந்தை போல் வாழ்ந்ததால் அவளை மணக்க முடியாது என்று அர்ஜுனன் விளக்குகிறான். நண்பர்களுக்கும் உறவினர்களுக்கும் தூதர்கள் அனுப்பப்படுகிறார்கள்; ஸ்ரீகிருஷ்ணர் அபிமன்யுவுடனும் வ்ருஷ்ணிகளுடனும் வர, த்ருபதனும் பல மன்னர்களும் வருகிறார்கள்; மத்ஸ்ய நகரில் பெரும் கொண்டாட்டத்துடன் அபிமன்யுவுக்கும் உத்தரைக்கும் திருமணம் நடக்கிறது.
summary.ml: രാജകുമാരിയോടൊപ്പം പിതാവിനെപ്പോലെ ഗുരുവായി താൻ കഴിഞ്ഞതിനാൽ അവളെ വിവാഹം കഴിക്കാനാകില്ലെന്ന് അർജുനൻ വിശദീകരിക്കുന്നു. സുഹൃത്തുക്കൾക്കും സഖ്യകക്ഷികൾക്കും ദൂതന്മാരെ അയയ്ക്കുന്നു; കൃഷ്ണൻ അഭിമന്യുവിനോടും വൃഷ്ണികളോടുമൊപ്പം വരുന്നു, ദ്രുപദനും നിരവധി രാജാക്കന്മാരും എത്തുന്നു. മത്സ്യനഗരത്തിൽ വലിയ ആഹ്ലാദത്തോടെ അഭിമന്യുവും ഉത്തരയും വിവാഹിതരാകുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 4.67; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Thu Dec  1 2011

verses.text: विराट उवाच

meaning.en: Virata said:

verses.text:
किमर्थं पाण्डवश्रेष्ठ भार्यां दुहितरं मम ।
प्रतिग्रहीतुं नेमां त्वं मया दत्तामिहेच्छसि ॥

meaning.en: "Best of the Pandavas, why do you not wish to accept my daughter, offered by me, as your wife?"

verses.text: अर्जुन उवाच

meaning.en: Arjuna said:

verses.text:
अन्तःपुरेऽहमुषितः सदा पश्यन्सुतां तव ।
रहस्यं च प्रकाशं च विश्वस्ता पितृवन्मयि ॥

meaning.en: "I lived always in your women's quarter and saw your daughter, in private and in public, and she trusted me like a father."

verses.text:
प्रियो बहुमतश्चाहं नर्तको गीतकोविदः ।
आचार्यवच्च मां नित्यं मन्यते दुहिता तव ॥

meaning.en: "Loved and esteemed, a dancer skilled in song, I was always regarded by your daughter as a teacher."

verses.text:
वयःस्थया तया राजन्सह संवत्सरोषितः ।
अतिशङ्का भवेत्स्थाने तव लोकस्य चाभिभो ॥

meaning.en: "I lived a year with her, who is grown, and suspicion might rightly arise, lord, in you and in the world."

verses.text:
तस्मान्निमन्त्रये त्वाहं दुहितुः पृथिवीपते ।
शुद्धो जितेन्द्रियो दान्तस्तस्याः शुद्धिः कृता मया ॥

meaning.en: "So, lord of the earth, I ask for your daughter as my son's bride. I am pure, self-controlled, and have made her pure."

verses.text:
स्नुषाया दुहितुर्वापि पुत्रे चात्मनि वा पुनः ।
अत्र शङ्कां न पश्यामि तेन शुद्धिर्भविष्यति ॥

meaning.en: "I see no room for suspicion in a daughter-in-law or daughter in relation to a son or oneself; therefore her purity will be clear."

verses.text:
अभिषङ्गादहं भीतो मिथ्याचारात्परंतप ।
स्नुषार्थमुत्तरां राजन्प्रतिगृह्णामि ते सुताम् ॥

meaning.en: "I fear slander and false conduct, scorcher of foes; so I accept your daughter Uttara for my daughter-in-law."

verses.text:
स्वस्रीयो वासुदेवस्य साक्षाद्देवशिशुर्यथा ।
दयितश्चक्रहस्तस्य बाल एवास्त्रकोविदः ॥

meaning.en: "He is the sister's son of Vasudeva, like a child of the gods, dear to the discus-bearer, a boy already skilled in weapons."

verses.text:
अभिमन्युर्महाबाहुः पुत्रो मम विशां पते ।
जामाता तव युक्तो वै भर्ता च दुहितुस्तव ॥

meaning.en: "Abhimanyu, mighty-armed lord of the people, is my son; he is a fit son-in-law for you and a fit husband for your daughter."

verses.text: विराट उवाच

meaning.en: Virata said:

verses.text:
उपपन्नं कुरुश्रेष्ठे कुन्तीपुत्रे धनंजये ।
य एवं धर्मनित्यश्च जातज्ञानश्च पाण्डवः ॥

meaning.en: "This is fitting for Dhananjaya, son of Kunti, best of the Kurus, a Pandava of constant dharma and born wisdom."

verses.text:
यत्कृत्यं मन्यसे पार्थ क्रियतां तदनन्तरम् ।
सर्वे कामाः समृद्धा मे संबन्धी यस्य मेऽर्जुनः ॥

meaning.en: "Do next whatever you think should be done, Partha. All my wishes are fulfilled, since Arjuna is to be my kin."

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
एवं ब्रुवति राजेन्द्रे कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः ।
अन्वजानात्स संयोगं समये मत्स्यपार्थयोः ॥

meaning.en: As the king spoke, Yudhishthira, son of Kunti, approved the union of the Matsya and the Parthas.

verses.text:
ततो मित्रेषु सर्वेषु वासुदेवे च भारत ।
प्रेषयामास कौन्तेयो विराटश्च महीपतिः ॥

meaning.en: Then Kunti's son and King Virata sent word to all their friends, and to Vasudeva, O Bharata.

verses.text:
ततस्त्रयोदशे वर्षे निवृत्ते पञ्च पाण्डवाः ।
उपप्लव्ये विराटस्य समपद्यन्त सर्वशः ॥

meaning.en: When the thirteenth year was complete, the five Pandavas gathered in every way at Upaplavya in Virata's realm.

verses.text:
तस्मिन्वसंश्च बीभत्सुरानिनाय जनार्दनम् ।
आनर्तेभ्योऽपि दाशार्हानभिमन्युं च पाण्डवः ॥

meaning.en: While there, the Pandava Bibhatsu brought Janardana, and the Dasharhas from Anarta, and Abhimanyu.

verses.text:
काशिराजश्च शैब्यश्च प्रीयमाणौ युधिष्ठिरे ।
अक्षौहिणीभ्यां सहितावागतौ पृथिवीपते ॥

meaning.en: The king of Kashi and Shaibya, pleased with Yudhishthira, came, O lord of the earth, each with an akshauhini.

verses.text:
अक्षौहिण्या च तेजस्वी यज्ञसेनो महाबलः ।
द्रौपद्याश्च सुता वीराः शिखण्डी चापराजितः ॥

meaning.en: The mighty Yajnasena Drupada came with an akshauhini, with the heroic sons of Draupadi and the unconquered Shikhandi.

verses.text:
धृष्टद्युम्नश्च दुर्धर्षः सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरः ।
समस्ताक्षौहिणीपाला यज्वानो भूरिदक्षिणाः ।
सर्वे शस्त्रास्त्रसंपन्नाः सर्वे शूरास्तनुत्यजः ॥

meaning.en: Dhrishtadyumna, hard to resist and best of all weapon-bearers, came too; all were lords of akshauhinis, sacrificers who gave rich fees, all skilled in weapons, all heroes ready to give up life.

verses.text:
तानागतानभिप्रेक्ष्य मत्स्यो धर्मभृतां वरः ।
प्रीतोऽभवद्दुहितरं दत्त्वा तामभिमन्यवे ॥

meaning.en: Seeing them arrive, the Matsya, best of upholders of dharma, was pleased, and gave his daughter to Abhimanyu.

verses.text:
ततः प्रत्युपयातेषु पार्थिवेषु ततस्ततः ।
तत्रागमद्वासुदेवो वनमाली हलायुधः ।
कृतवर्मा च हार्दिक्यो युयुधानश्च सात्यकिः ॥

meaning.en: Then, as the kings arrived from various places, there came Vasudeva, garlanded with forest flowers, and plow-bearing Balarama, Kritavarma son of Hridika, and Yuyudhana Satyaki.

verses.text:
अनाधृष्टिस्तथाक्रूरः साम्बो निशठ एव च ।
अभिमन्युमुपादाय सह मात्रा परंतपाः ॥

meaning.en: Anadhrishti, Akrura, Samba and Nishatha, scorchers of foes, came with Abhimanyu and his mother.

verses.text:
इन्द्रसेनादयश्चैव रथैस्तैः सुसमाहितैः ।
आययुः सहिताः सर्वे परिसंवत्सरोषिताः ॥

meaning.en: Indrasena and others also came, all together, in their well-equipped chariots, after spending a full year away.

verses.text:
दश नागसहस्राणि हयानां च शतायुतम् ।
रथानामर्बुदं पूर्णं निखर्वं च पदातिनाम् ॥

meaning.en: They brought ten thousand elephants, a hundred thousand horses, a full arbuda of chariots and a nikharva of foot-soldiers.

verses.text:
वृष्ण्यन्धकाश्च बहवो भोजाश्च परमौजसः ।
अन्वयुर्वृष्णिशार्दूलं वासुदेवं महाद्युतिम् ॥

meaning.en: Many Vrishnis, Andhakas and the mighty Bhojas followed Vasudeva, the radiant tiger of the Vrishnis.

verses.text:
पारिबर्हं ददौ कृष्णः पाण्डवानां महात्मनाम् ।
स्त्रियो रत्नानि वासांसि पृथक्पृथगनेकशः ।
ततो विवाहो विधिवद्ववृते मत्स्यपार्थयोः ॥

meaning.en: Krishna gave the great-souled Pandavas bridal gifts: women, jewels and garments, each in separate numbers. Then the wedding of the Matsya's daughter and Partha's son was held according to rule.

verses.text:
ततः शङ्खाश्च भेर्यश्च गोमुखाडम्बरास्तथा ।
पार्थैः संयुज्यमानस्य नेदुर्मत्स्यस्य वेश्मनि ॥

meaning.en: Then conches, drums and cow-horn trumpets sounded in the house of the Matsya king, who was now united with the Parthas.

verses.text:
उच्चावचान्मृगाञ्जघ्नुर्मेध्यांश्च शतशः पशून् ।
सुरामैरेयपानानि प्रभूतान्यभ्यहारयन् ॥

meaning.en: They killed deer of many kinds and hundreds of animals fit for sacrifice, and brought in plentiful wine and liquor.

verses.text:
गायनाख्यानशीलाश्च नटा वैतालिकास्तथा ।
स्तुवन्तस्तानुपातिष्ठन्सूताश्च सह मागधैः ॥

meaning.en: Singers, tellers of tales, actors and bards waited on them with praises, as did the sutas with the magadhas.

verses.text:
सुदेष्णां च पुरस्कृत्य मत्स्यानां च वरस्त्रियः ।
आजग्मुश्चारुसर्वाङ्ग्यः सुमृष्टमणिकुण्डलाः ॥

meaning.en: Led by Sudeshna, the finest women of the Matsyas, lovely in every limb, with polished jeweled earrings, came.

verses.text:
वर्णोपपन्नास्ता नार्यो रूपवत्यः स्वलंकृताः ।
सर्वाश्चाभ्यभवत्कृष्णा रूपेण यशसा श्रिया ॥

meaning.en: Those women, fair, beautiful and well adorned, were all outshone by Krishna Draupadi in beauty, fame and splendor.

verses.text:
परिवार्योत्तरां तास्तु राजपुत्रीमलंकृताम् ।
सुतामिव महेन्द्रस्य पुरस्कृत्योपतस्थिरे ॥

meaning.en: They surrounded Uttara, the adorned princess, and attended her as if she were Mahendra's daughter.

verses.text:
तां प्रत्यगृह्णात्कौन्तेयः सुतस्यार्थे धनंजयः ।
सौभद्रस्यानवद्याङ्गीं विराटतनयां तदा ॥

meaning.en: Then Dhananjaya, son of Kunti, accepted Virata's blameless daughter for the son of Subhadra.

verses.text:
तत्रातिष्ठन्महाराजो रूपमिन्द्रस्य धारयन् ।
स्नुषां तां प्रतिजग्राह कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः ॥

meaning.en: There the great king Yudhishthira, son of Kunti, who bore the beauty of Indra, took her as his daughter-in-law.

verses.text:
प्रतिगृह्य च तां पार्थः पुरस्कृत्य जनार्दनम् ।
विवाहं कारयामास सौभद्रस्य महात्मनः ॥

meaning.en: Having accepted her, Partha, with Janardana at his head, had the wedding of the great-souled son of Subhadra performed.

verses.text:
तस्मै सप्त सहस्राणि हयानां वातरंहसाम् ।
द्वे च नागशते मुख्ये प्रादाद्बहु धनं तदा ॥

meaning.en: Virata gave him seven thousand horses swift as wind, two hundred of the best elephants, and much wealth.

verses.text:
कृते विवाहे तु तदा धर्मपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः ।
ब्राह्मणेभ्यो ददौ वित्तं यदुपाहरदच्युतः ॥

meaning.en: When the wedding was done, Yudhishthira, son of Dharma, gave to the brahmins the wealth Krishna had brought.

verses.text:
गोसहस्राणि रत्नानि वस्त्राणि विविधानि च ।
भूषणानि च मुख्यानि यानानि शयनानि च ॥

meaning.en: He gave thousands of cattle, jewels, varied garments, fine ornaments, vehicles and beds.

verses.text:
तन्महोत्सवसंकाशं हृष्टपुष्टजनावृतम् ।
नगरं मत्स्यराजस्य शुशुभे भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: The city of the Matsya king, thronged with cheerful, well-fed people, shone like a great festival, O best of the Bharatas.
